data.action: 在空中完全拉满金色阿波罗光之巨弓，深红光子翼喷薄能量，眼神冷静凌厉如霜
data.camera: dynamic low angle, sweeping wide shot, epic warhead impact
data.description: 被硝烟与赤红火海吞噬的残破空域之中，伊卡洛斯完全解放战略作战形态。白羽化作狂暴喷射的深红光子能量翼，左眼变色战术瞄准镜锁定目标。她悬立虚空拉满黄金巨弓「阿波罗」，炽烈耀眼的毁灭光矢将整片天幕照亮如白昼，平日温顺的天使在这一刻显现出摧毁地表的绝对神罚威能——「变态主人……由我来彻底消灭！」
data.lighting: 阿波罗光矢爆发的极亮炽金强光与深红能量翼的烈焰粒子光效
data.location: 雷云密布与高热能量涡流天空战场
data.promptProse: Ikaros holds the golden Apollon bow in her left hand and draws its string with her right toward the unseen target. Her transformed crimson photon wings spread through smoke as the arrow lights her face.
data.title: 伊卡洛斯 · 空之女王阿波罗天诛之箭
data.identityProseOverride: Ikaros from Sora no Otoshimono, an angeloid with long pink twintails, an ahoge, green eyes, mechanical ear winglets, a metal collar with a broken chain and crimson photon wings.
data.animaCaption: Her left hand holds Apollon while her right draws its string toward the unseen target.
